capability: Track 55 live weak scaling certification proof across representative HPC scenarios.

hardware.cpu_model: Replace with CPU model for every node class used.
hardware.cpu_topology: Replace with sockets, cores, threads, cache, and rank or LP placement topology.
hardware.memory_topology: Replace with NUMA nodes, memory size, locality policy, and bandwidth notes.
hardware.accelerator_model: Replace with GPU or accelerator model, count, and memory, or state none when not used.
hardware.driver: Replace with accelerator, network, MPI, and storage driver versions relevant to the run.

system.operating_system: Replace with OS image, kernel, architecture, and cluster image identifier.

toolchain.rust_toolchain: Replace with rustc and cargo versions from the pushed proof run.
toolchain.compiler: Replace with C/C++/CUDA compiler versions when relevant.
toolchain.mpi_implementation: Replace with MPI implementation and version or none when not used.
toolchain.scheduler: Replace with Slurm, Kubernetes, Batch, or provider scheduler version and queue details.

environment.RUSTFLAGS: Replace with effective value or none
environment.LD_LIBRARY_PATH: Replace with effective value or none

runtime.input_scenario: Weak scaling profile covering DES, ABM, hybrid, distributed, MPI/gRPC, NUMA/I/O, FMI, and scheduler categories as upstream evidence allows.

storage.filesystem_or_object_store: Replace with immutable artifact store for raw weak scaling results, plots, logs, and manifests.

result.expected: Weak scaling raw results include throughput, efficiency, memory, I/O, rollback, GVT, GPU, and FMI metrics for all certified scenario categories.
result.observed: Replace with measured weak scaling summary and explicit excluded categories, if any.

review.reviewer: Replace with reviewer name or handle.

waiver.expires: Replace with none only after this template becomes live-hpc evidence.
